natural_press.lr_recovery_scope: update 시작시에만 actor LR 복구; update 내부 KL retry 감소·rollback·한도는 기존 그대로
natural_press.inactive_execution: 과제 비담당 손가락과 엄지는 경계 hold, 오른손6잔차0; 단계별 행동 잠금 없음

initial_distribution.rng: 공식 CPU torch RNG 저장복원; episode 경계 정렬 reset

natural_press.likelihood: 과제 전체 고정 활성축의 독립 Gaussian tanh; 비활성축은 표본/logp/entropy/KL 제외

aligned_start.reset: 실측 도착 q/body와 역변환 기타 COM root; 과거 시계 복원 없음
aligned_start.success_scope: 조건부 팔/과제 손가락 제어; 자유 J33 성과 아님

progress_schema.source_target_index: zero-based compiled task.targets index; -1 invalid; target_id mapping in episode log
progress_schema.selection: audible current note first; else existing E4 preparation selector; next preparation beats old release
progress_schema.aligned: own unchanged E4 hover ready AND shared wrist guide ready; no action lock
progress_schema.hold: own selected target: onset<=score_time<end AND candidate AND NOT wrong
progress_schema.release: previous own target ended less than0.25s ago, only when no current/preparing own target
progress_schema.target_timer: seconds since this finger selected this target; only this target replacement/reset clears it
progress_schema.target_changes: source-index changes including entering/leaving no-target state
progress_schema.aligned_timer: continuous own alignment before press; own readiness/phase loss clears it
progress_schema.clean_timer: continuous own audible clean; own loss/target replacement clears it
progress_schema.episode_seconds: actual240Hz samples per finger and phase; target changes do not clear totals
progress_schema.behavior: observation and diagnostics only; no reward, action gate, PD or physical-state mutation

natural_press.timing_measurement: 평가/재생의 실제240Hz 원장을 읽기만 함; tail 포함 엄격값과 내부값 분리
